notes: Budgets are based on the npm tarball generated from version 1.0.6 plus headroom for docs and generated API references.
Run pnpm run build before pnpm run check:package-size so dist reflects the current source.
Repository-only demo media is excluded from the npm artifact so runtime and operational files retain budget headroom.

The storage lifecycle release adds public pagination/export APIs, generated TypeDoc pages, and operational backup documentation; the file-count budget increases to 170 while byte budgets remain unchanged.

The observability release adds a public runtime, OpenMetrics/OTLP modules, generated API references, and operator documentation. Internal superpowers design/plan files are excluded; the measured artifact contains 213 files, so the budget is 220 while compressed and unpacked byte budgets remain unchanged.

The incident workflow release adds three MCP tools, bounded observation-window APIs, review-first artifact types, and generated TypeDoc references. The measured artifact contains 243 files, so the file-count budget is 250 while byte budgets remain unchanged.
